text.autoconfig.dynamicfov.title: Classic Join Animation settings
text.autoconfig.dynamicfov.option.initia: From what depth should the camera lerp?
text.autoconfig.dynamicfov.option.overal: How long should the animation be?
text.autoconfig.dynamicfov.option.fadeFr: Should the animation begin from a black screen?
text.autoconfig.dynamicfov.option.easing: Change the polynomial order for animation (1 = Linear, 5 = Quintic, ... upto 10).
text.autoconfig.dynamicfov.option.worldL:
Change this if game lags upon first ever render.

This option applies a delay for these first launches,
so that you can see the entire animation.
text.autoconfig.dynamicfov.option.useBez:
Do you want to us the new Bezier system?
This disables polynomial curve.
Disable this to use polynomial curve.
text.autoconfig.dynamicfov.option.bezier:
Format: x1, y1, x2, y2. 
!! Bad formatting may yield bad result !!
